p: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: #2c2c2e; margin: 0 0 16px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; color: #2c2c2e; text-align: left; margin: 48px 0 16px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #d71a1b
h2_first: font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; color: #2c2c2e; text-align: left; margin: 0 0 16px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #d71a1b
h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #2c2c2e; text-align: left; margin: 28px 0 12px
blockquote: background-color: #f4f4f6; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #2c2c2e; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
pre: background-color: #f4f4f6; border: 1px solid #e3e3e6; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; margin: 0 0 16px; letter-spacing: 0
code: color: #2c2c2e; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #f4f4f6; color: #d71a1b; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
list_item: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: #2c2c2e; margin: 0 0 8px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #f4f4f6; color: #2c2c2e; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #e3e3e6; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 14px; text-align: left
td: border: 1px solid #e3e3e6; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #2c2c2e; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
